title: andropogon gayanus var. argyrophoeus
intro: Andropogon gayanus var. argyrophoeus, commonly known as White Grass, is a species of grass native to Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of White Grass are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, promote tissue repair, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of White Grass include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
